description: This file contains PHP classes that implement compilation logic for the {section} Smarty template tag, including handling of attributes, code generation for loop constructs, and compiling related {sectionelse} and {/section} tags.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Section
classes.description: Handles compilation of the {section} tag in Smarty templates, enabling loop constructs with detailed attribute parsing and code generation.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Sectionelse
classes.description: Handles compilation of the {sectionelse} tag for {section} in Smarty templates, managing the transition to else logic within compiled PHP code.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Sectionclose
classes.description: Handles compilation of the {/section} closing tag, finalizing the loop logic and cleaning up compiled code.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Main method in each class that transforms template tags into executable PHP code, with specific logic for {section}, {sectionelse}, and {/section} tags respectively.
